summary: Telefônica Brasil S.A. filed a Form 6-K on June 17, 2026, reporting that its Board approved the merger of Fibrasil Infraestrutura e Fibra Ótica S.A., its wholly-owned subsidiary, into Telefônica Brasil, effective August 1, 2026. Since Fibrasil is wholly owned, the merger involves no share issuance, capital increase, or change in shareholder structure. The transaction is an internal restructuring to absorb a wholly owned subsidiary at book value (R$812.6 million). No premium, exchange ratio, or advisor is mentioned. This is an ordinary corporate consolidation with no external market impact.
